description: Read a multi-memory context pack. Requires memory:read and does not change content. Use when many memories need explicit budgets; use recall for lightweight answer or get_project_context for project snapshot. max_items/max_tokens bound rendered output.

agent_id.description: Optional client-supplied agent label for memory attribution.

agent_instance_id.description: Optional stable, non-secret agent instance ID for per-client attribution.

bucket.description: Accessible bucket filter; % includes all accessible buckets.

limit.description: Candidate-result limit; 0 derives it from the item/token budgets.

max_items.description: Maximum memories rendered in the context pack.

max_tokens.description: Approximate token budget for the rendered context pack.

memory_type.description: Memory type filter; auto searches the normal mixed set.

output_json.description: True returns the full structured pack; false returns rendered context text.

path_filter.description: Case-insensitive memory-path pattern; % matches all paths.

query.description: Natural-language query used to rank memories for the context pack.

scope.description: Optional authorized scope; blank uses the token default.

name: recall_context

result.description: Human-readable text or JSON requested by output_json.
